invariants.name: proper-probabilistic-score-reporting
invariants.expected: Brier score and log loss computed from frozen probability/outcome rows

invariants.name: reliability-bin-transparency
invariants.expected: ECE is accompanied by per-bin counts, mean probability, observed frequency and absolute gap

invariants.name: selective-risk-reporting
invariants.expected: risk and coverage are reported at each pre-registered confidence threshold

invariants.name: interval-coverage-and-sharpness
invariants.expected: empirical nominal interval coverage is paired with mean interval width and mean absolute error

invariants.name: worst-stratum-reporting
invariants.expected: worst sensor-group and worst-site interval coverage are reported

invariants.name: whole-site-holdout-isolation
invariants.expected: training and evaluation site sets are disjoint and all evaluation observations map to the holdout inventory

invariants.name: deterministic-input-order-invariance
invariants.expected: reordering rows does not change computed metrics

invariants.name: site-cluster-bootstrap
invariants.expected: confidence intervals resample whole evaluation sites/campaigns, preserve within-site rows, and are deterministic for a frozen seed

invariants.name: minimum-independent-cluster-count
invariants.expected: cluster bootstrap rejects fewer than three evaluation sites

negativeControls.mutation: Place a site ID in both trainingSiteIds and evaluationSiteIds.
negativeControls.reason: Whole-site holdout leakage invalidates independent evaluation.

negativeControls.mutation: Attach a prediction or metrology observation to a site absent from evaluationSiteIds.
negativeControls.reason: Every scored observation must belong to the frozen evaluation inventory.

negativeControls.mutation: Use a probability below zero or above one.
negativeControls.reason: A predictive probability must be within the unit interval.

negativeControls.mutation: Provide a metrology interval with lower95 greater than upper95.
negativeControls.reason: An inverted interval is malformed and cannot be scored.

negativeControls.mutation: Use fewer than three independent evaluation sites for the cluster bootstrap.
negativeControls.reason: A point-level bootstrap must not be substituted for absent independent site clusters.

qualificationBoundary: Synthetic scores qualify metric implementations only. Real qualification requires independent whole-site holdouts and independently established reference measurements.
